body.message:
The Elite Business Bay listing is available from 30th August and you can stay as long as you like, extending in 3-month blocks at a confirmed rate each time. There's a 1BR at AED 7,000/month and a 2BR at AED 7,500/month, both fully all-inclusive covering water, electricity, internet, and VAT, with just a refundable security deposit of AED 1,500 or AED 2,000 respectively.

Which size were you considering?
